spans.s: पथि॑ v. पथ्.
पथ m. path, course, way (mostly a. —˚).
पथिक m. traveller, wanderer.
पथिकसार्थ m. company of travellers, caravan.
पथिकृ॑त् a. preparing a path.
पथिपा॑ a. protecting ways.
पथिर॑क्षस् a. protecting ways.
पथि˚र॑क्षि a. protecting ways.
पथिष्ठा॑ a. standing in or on a way.
पथिस्थ a. the same + being on the way, going.
पथेष्ठा॑ a. = पथिष्ठा.
*पथोपदेशक m. guide, leader (of the way).*

पा॑थस् n. spot, place (also ˚थिस् n.);
 water.

पाथेय n. provender for a journey;
 p. ˚वन्त्.
पाथोज n. lotus-flower, ˚जिनी f. the lotus plant.
पाथोद m. cloud (water-giver or -bearer).
पाथो˚धर m. cloud (water-giver or -bearer).
पाथोधि m. the see (receptacle of water).
पाथोनाथ m. the ocean (lord of the waters).
पाथोनिधि m. = पथोधि.
